family_description: Replan only the affected seven-day period after a ward demand spike, minimizing changes and notifying staff.
instruction: Demand increased for the next seven days. Update only affected shifts where practical, keep unaffected assignments stable, and notify anyone whose assignment changes. Send roster-change notices to each employee whose shift changes or who is named in a decided request. Include recipient_id, shift_date, shift_type, and ward_id in messaging.send; unrelated messages without those shift fields do not count as roster notifications. This episode accepts at most 3,000 state-changing tool calls and at most 10,000 tool calls in total; plan large rebuilds accordingly. These positions were already open before this request and must also be covered where the rules allow (date, ward, shift): 2026-03-15 ward-01 late; 2026-03-15 ward-02 late; 2026-03-15 ward-02 night; 2026-03-21 ward-01 night; 2026-03-21 ward-02 night; 2026-03-22 ward-01 late; 2026-03-22 ward-01 night; 2026-03-22 ward-02 early; 2026-03-22 ward-02 late; 2026-03-22 ward-02 night. Follow the active written rules, do not claim work is covered unless the roster actually meets its headcount and qualification requirements, and leave the clock records unchanged.
reporting_requirements: Use integer minutes for work and discrepancy totals.
Give a specific reason for each declined swap or uncovered slot.
Report costs in the task currency and do not exceed the agency budget.
title: F04_demand_spike: Demand Spike
